BEST Upcoming RPGs 2026 - The Blockbuster Lineup For The Rest Of The Year
The second half of 2026 is shaping up to be a blockbuster season for RPGs. Following a quiet summer, the RPG genre is about to launch a full-scale assault on our free time with a lineup that spans brutal Soulslikes, tactical turn-based strategy, and narrative-driven epics.

In this video, we will be exploring the premise, release dates, and key features of the most anticipated RPGs dropping between August until the end of the year. We have sorted these upcoming RPG behemoths by their release dates so you can plan your gaming calendar accordingly.
